common: Use case: game-asset. Create ONE original isolated player-body source sprite for the fictional Spend Network theme of the RevealLine game. It is a friendly AI helper/logistics machine, not an official product mascot. TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP-DOWN camera, directly overhead, no perspective tilt, no standing/front-view humanoid. Modern polished 16-bit arcade pixel-art vocabulary: broad opaque square color clusters, stepped outlines, very simple large internal panels, only restrained shading; shape and forward direction must read at 24–32 pixels. Use the existing game palette as color guidance: ivory #edf2ed, deep blue ink #173747, light blue #87cbe0, warm gold #e2c775, muted blue #85a8b6, with small peach #e69477 accents if helpful. Large ivory and light-blue masses must remain bright against a dark field. No magenta/neon-retro palette swap. North/forward is UP at 12 o'clock, emphasized by an attached light-blue/gold front module; stern fittings at bottom. Complete connected body and every appendage fully inside the square frame, approximately 75–80% maximum span with at least 10% transparent margin on every side. Body panels are opaque; outside and intentional open gaps must be genuinely transparent alpha, not white/black/checkerboard paint. No ground plane, cast floor shadow, background, text, letters, numbers, currency symbols, logo, recycling emblem, copied game character, or claim to depict the official Coupa Navi mascot. No loose floating parts, no firing/projectile/trail/impact effects, no deployed tool effect. All machinery is fictional and static; this is one source body, not a sprite sheet or completed animation rig. Output one square 1024×1024 transparent PNG original.

rows.name: Savings Seeker
rows.shape: Compact pear-shaped survey helper. A large warm-gold circular search lens embedded in its broad ivory forward half points north; a short attached cyan wedge at the top clarifies heading. Two short rounded side paddles and a narrower dark-blue stern with two tiny gold sockets. Read as one friendly lens-bot, not a saucer, aircraft, or magnifying-glass icon. Keep the lens and pear silhouette dominant, no fine greebles.
